known.via: English Wikipedia "Hautes-Côtes de Nuits" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A Burgundy sub-region on top of and behind the Côte de Nuits escarpment, in valleys and slopes. Its one appellation covers red and rosé from Pinot Noir and white from Chardonnay. It has no Premier Cru vineyards.
